name: vclo-by-rohas
description: vCLO is a free, open-source AI legal team with one virtual Chief Legal Officer, nine specialist virtual lawyers, India Counsel, MVP US and UK Counsel, 183 specialist legal skills, nine coordinated workflows and company-registry access.

interface.longDescription: One vCLO installation gives lawyers and businesses a virtual Chief Legal Officer, nine specialist virtual lawyers, India Counsel, MVP US and UK Counsel, 183 specialist legal skills and nine coordinated workflows. It coordinates complex matters such as M&A due diligence, contract negotiation, litigation, arbitration, financing, compliance, data-breach response and internal investigations. The jurisdiction lawyers supply local-law routing, authority, procedure and verification rules within the same plugin.
defaultPrompt: Run buyer-side legal due diligence on this acquisition and consolidate the key risks.
Review this MSA for the customer, propose redlines, and prepare negotiation positions.
Prepare our litigation case strategy from these pleadings, evidence, and deadlines.
